# CallForges

> CallForges is a cloud phone system for sales and support teams: local numbers in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, a power and parallel dialer, AI call notes, an AI voice agent, two-way SMS, call routing and CRM call logging. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.

The app is at https://app.callforges.com (sign up at https://app.callforges.com/signup). Plans and prices: https://callforges.com/pricing.html. Help center: https://callforges.com/help. The full text of this site: https://callforges.com/llms-full.txt. AI tools can connect to a CallForges workspace through its MCP server: https://callforges.com/for-agents.html.

## Product

- [Cloud Dialer, Auto Dialer & AI Voice Agent](https://callforges.com/): CallForges is a cloud phone with local US, UK and Australian numbers, a power auto dialer, AI call notes and an AI voice agent that picks up 24/7.
- [Auto Dialer](https://callforges.com/auto-dialer.html): The CallForges auto dialer rings your list from a local number, inside each contact's working hours. Power and parallel dialing, voicemail drop, CRM sync and AI summaries from $15 per user.
- [AI Voice Agent](https://callforges.com/ai-agent.html): The CallForges AI voice agent answers your line 24/7 in 30+ languages, from your own help docs, and books a callback for your team. 100 agent minutes per user on Business, $0.12 a minute after.
- [Pricing](https://callforges.com/pricing.html): CallForges plans start at $15 per user. No seat minimum, 100 to 1,000 free minutes a month for calls to and from the US, UK, Australia and Canada, and numbers in 56 countries and territories.
- [CallForges vs Aircall, JustCall, Quo & Dialpad](https://callforges.com/compare.html): Compare CallForges with Aircall, JustCall, Quo and Dialpad on price, seat minimums, auto dialer access, AI features, SMS and international calling.

## For AI agents

- [For AI agents](https://callforges.com/for-agents.html): Read about CallForges as plain text, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or Claude Code to your workspace through the CallForges MCP server.
- [MCP server](https://api.callforges.com/mcp): the MCP endpoint for AI tools; setup is on the For AI agents page.

## Help center

- [Start your free trial](https://callforges.com/help/articles/start-your-free-trial): Create your account and workspace, see what the 14-day trial includes, and add a card or choose a plan before it ends.
- [Make your first call](https://callforges.com/help/articles/make-your-first-call): Get your number, open the dialer, allow your microphone and place your first call from the browser, with what the trial allows.
- [Place a call from the dialer](https://callforges.com/help/articles/place-a-call): Open the dialer from any page, choose the number you call from, dial a number or a contact, use the in-call controls and log the outcome.
- [Transfer a call](https://callforges.com/help/articles/transfer-a-call): Send a live call to a teammate, a team or another number, either at once or after you talk to them first.
- [Create a campaign](https://callforges.com/help/articles/create-a-campaign): Set up a power or parallel dialer campaign: the dialer type, the number you call from, your leads and the hours leads may be called.
- [Start, pause, resume or stop a campaign](https://callforges.com/help/articles/start-pause-resume-stop): Run a campaign: start dialing, pause and resume, stop it for good, and read what each lead's status means.
- [How the parallel dialer works](https://callforges.com/help/articles/how-the-parallel-dialer-works): Ring several leads at once, talk to the first person who answers, and choose what happens to the lines that were still ringing.
- [Build a call workflow](https://callforges.com/help/articles/build-a-call-workflow): Decide what callers get on your numbers: business hours, who rings, menus, forwarding, queues and voicemail, then publish it.
- [Buy a phone number](https://callforges.com/help/articles/buy-a-phone-number): Pick a local, mobile or toll-free number, choose its owner and who can use it, and buy it in two steps.
- [Port your number to CallForges](https://callforges.com/help/articles/port-your-number): Move numbers you already have with another provider into your workspace: US local numbers through a wizard, everything else on request.
- [Get started with SMS](https://callforges.com/help/articles/get-started-with-sms): Which of your numbers can send SMS, SMS in the free trial, where your conversations are, and how SMS is charged.
- [Register for SMS in the US (A2P 10DLC)](https://callforges.com/help/articles/register-for-sms-in-the-us): Register your US numbers with the carriers: the campaign's steps, its statuses, business vetting, what happens when your plan ends, and the fees.
- [Send and receive SMS](https://callforges.com/help/articles/send-and-receive-sms): Send an SMS from the Inbox, get replies, read its delivery status, schedule it for later and keep drafts.
- [The Messaging Inbox](https://callforges.com/help/articles/the-messaging-inbox): The Inbox's tabs and filters, assigning, closing and archiving SMS conversations, bulk actions, and who sees which numbers.
- [Who gets a new SMS conversation](https://callforges.com/help/articles/who-gets-a-new-sms-conversation): Remain assigned, first response or round robin, who owns a conversation you start, and the assignee when it closes or the contact opts out.
- [SMS opt-outs: STOP and START](https://callforges.com/help/articles/sms-opt-outs-stop-and-start): What happens when a contact replies STOP, START or HELP, unassigning or archiving on opt-out, and the list of opted-out contacts.
- [Out-of-hours SMS reply](https://callforges.com/help/articles/sms-out-of-hours-reply): Set a number's opening hours and an automatic SMS reply for contacts who write while it is closed, and how often it is sent.
- [SMS signatures and saved replies](https://callforges.com/help/articles/sms-signatures-and-saved-replies): A signature for each user, for one number or for a user on a number, which one is used, and saved replies your team can insert.
- [Send SMS to contacts in other countries](https://callforges.com/help/articles/sms-to-other-countries): Which countries' numbers can send SMS, what a contact abroad sees and whether they can reply, US contacts, and which number to send from.
- [SMS length and sending rules](https://callforges.com/help/articles/sms-length-and-sending-rules): Characters per SMS, long messages sent in parts, the counter under the message box, quiet hours, and what is checked before an SMS goes.
- [Invite users](https://callforges.com/help/articles/invite-users): Invite teammates by e-mail, choose their role, and resend or revoke an invite that hasn't been accepted yet.
- [Plans and seats](https://callforges.com/help/articles/plans-and-seats): Choose Starter, Business or Scale, pay monthly or annually, add seats, upgrade or downgrade, and what happens if a payment fails.
- [Add credits](https://callforges.com/help/articles/add-credits): Top up your workspace's prepaid credits by card, see what credits pay for, track every charge, and what happens when credits run out.
- [Attio integration](https://callforges.com/help/articles/attio-integration): Connect Attio, map users, log calls as notes or Calls records, create people for unknown numbers, import people, log past calls and disconnect.
- [HubSpot integration](https://callforges.com/help/articles/hubspot-integration): Connect HubSpot, map users to owners, log calls as HubSpot calls or notes, create contacts for unknown numbers, import contacts, log past calls and disconnect.
- [Pipedrive integration](https://callforges.com/help/articles/pipedrive-integration): Connect Pipedrive, map users, log calls as Call activities or notes, create people for unknown numbers, import people, log past calls and disconnect.
- [HighLevel integration](https://callforges.com/help/articles/highlevel-integration): Connect a HighLevel sub-account, map users, log calls in conversations or as notes, tag dispositions, import contacts, log past calls and disconnect.
- [Clio integration](https://callforges.com/help/articles/clio-integration): Connect Clio Manage, map users, log calls as phone calls on contacts and matters, add time entries, log past calls and disconnect.

- [Missed call text back: how it works and how to set it up](https://callforges.com/blog/set-up-missed-call-text-back): Missed call text back texts every caller you miss from the number they rang. How it works, and how to set it up in CallForges, step by step.
- [Is missed call text back legal? US, UK and EU rules](https://callforges.com/blog/is-missed-call-text-back-legal): Generally yes, when the text answers the call and sells nothing. What the TCPA, STOP replies, 10DLC and UK and EU law ask of a missed call text.
- [Clio sales dialer: a dialer for law firms that use Clio](https://callforges.com/blog/dialer-for-law-firms-clio): A Clio sales dialer calls your list and logs each call in Clio Manage, on the contact and its one open matter. Who a firm may call, and how to set it up.
- [Dialpad vs Aircall: pricing, dialers and a better pick](https://callforges.com/blog/dialpad-vs-aircall): Dialpad is cheaper to start and Aircall has the cheaper power dialer. CallForges beats both for teams that dial: both dialers on every plan from $15 a user.
- [Missed call text back for contractors, plumbers and HVAC](https://callforges.com/blog/missed-call-text-back-contractors): Missed call text back texts every caller a contractor misses on a roof or in a crawl space. What to send by trade, when to send it, and how to set it up.
- [How to get STIR/SHAKEN verification for your phone number](https://callforges.com/blog/register-business-with-carriers): STIR/SHAKEN verification comes from the phone company that carries your calls. What to have ready, the steps in CallForges, and how long level A takes.
- [What is call attestation? A, B and C explained](https://callforges.com/blog/what-is-call-attestation): Call attestation is the trust level a phone company signs on your caller ID: A, B or C. Who sets it, what decides the letter, and how to get level A.
- [Missed call text back in the UK: which number can text](https://callforges.com/blog/missed-call-text-back-uk): Missed call text back in the UK goes from a 07 mobile number, since most 01 and 02 numbers can't text. Which number to use, what PECR says and how to set it up.
- [Business voicemail greeting examples: 12 professional scripts](https://callforges.com/blog/business-voicemail-greeting-examples): Twelve business voicemail greeting examples to copy, from after hours and lunch to a sales line, a support desk and a business cell, and how to set yours.
- [How to send international SMS to customers abroad](https://callforges.com/blog/send-international-sms): To send international SMS, text from a number in your contact's country where you can. Which numbers text where, what each country needs, and the cost.
- [Christmas voicemail greeting examples for business](https://callforges.com/blog/christmas-voicemail-greeting): Christmas voicemail greeting examples for business: a script for each day from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day, plus Boxing Day, on-call and out of office.
- [10DLC registration form: what to enter in each field](https://callforges.com/blog/10dlc-registration-form): What to type in each field of the US texting registration, from business details to samples, consent and fees, and the mistakes that get a campaign rejected.
- [AI receptionist making things up: how to stop wrong answers](https://callforges.com/blog/ai-receptionist-wrong-answers): AI receptionists give wrong answers when they guess past their sources or read old docs. The causes, the fix for each, and a test routine.
- [AI voice agent for leasing inquiries](https://callforges.com/blog/ai-voice-agent-leasing-inquiries): An AI voice agent answers leasing calls after hours from your own listings and policies, books showing requests as callbacks and gets emergencies to your team.
- [AI voice agent pricing: what you actually pay](https://callforges.com/blog/ai-voice-agent-pricing): AI voice agents are priced per minute, per call or as a bundle. What a minute covers, and the CallForges price: $0.12 a minute, pooled minutes on Business.
- [Auto dialer software: what to look for before you buy](https://callforges.com/blog/auto-dialer-software-buyers-guide): A buyer's checklist for auto dialer software: dialer types, voicemail drop, caller ID, calling hours, CRM logging, seat minimums and minutes, with our answers.
- [Callers hang up on AI receptionists: how to keep them on](https://callforges.com/blog/callers-hang-up-on-ai-receptionist): Callers hang up when an AI receptionist hides what it is, talks too long or traps them. The causes, most likely first, and the fix for each.

- [Insurance agents: why your number gets flagged as spam](https://callforges.com/blog/insurance-agent-number-flagged-spam): Aged leads and double dials make an agent's number look like a robocaller's, and AEP adds the volume. Why it gets flagged, and how to get it clean again.
- [Why CallForges is the best dialer you can rely on](https://callforges.com/blog/why-callforges-is-the-best-dialer): We believe a dialer is only as good as the calls people pick up. How CallForges earns the pick-up: verified calls under your name, at an hour people can talk.
- [Phone number reputation: why calls get labeled spam](https://callforges.com/blog/phone-number-reputation): Networks and call-blocking apps score every number that calls. What lowers the score, what the labels look like, and how to register, check and fix a number.
- [What is CNAM? How caller ID names work in the US](https://callforges.com/blog/what-is-cnam): CNAM is the caller ID name shown with your number. It isn't sent with the call: the called person's carrier looks it up in a CNAM database.
- [What is STIR/SHAKEN? Verified caller ID for business calls](https://callforges.com/blog/what-is-stir-shaken): STIR/SHAKEN is how US phone companies sign calls so the receiving network can trust the caller ID. Level A, the highest, needs your business verified.
- [Power dialer vs predictive dialer: what's the difference?](https://callforges.com/blog/power-dialer-vs-predictive-dialer): A power dialer rings one lead per rep; a predictive dialer rings more leads than you have free agents. Which suits a small team, and the dropped-call rules.
- [What is a power dialer?](https://callforges.com/blog/what-is-a-power-dialer): A power dialer calls your leads one after another, so the next call starts when the last one ends. How it works, who it suits and how to set one up.
- [What is an auto dialer? How it works, step by step](https://callforges.com/blog/what-is-an-auto-dialer): An auto dialer calls the numbers on your list and puts a rep through when someone answers. How it works step by step, the main types and what to look for.
- [Power dialer vs parallel dialer: which one should your team use?](https://callforges.com/blog/power-dialer-vs-parallel-dialer): A power dialer rings one lead at a time, a parallel dialer rings several. Which one fits cold B2B lists, warm leads and consumer calls, and the trade-off.
- [What is a parallel dialer?](https://callforges.com/blog/what-is-a-parallel-dialer): A parallel dialer rings several leads at once and connects you to the first who answers. How it works, when two answer, and the US and UK calling rules.
